prompt:
A high-fidelity visual design mockup of a MOBILE WEB PAGE, portrait phone viewport, full-bleed screen design. Flat screen design only: no phone hardware frame, no browser chrome, no hands, no device photograph. It is a birthday party invitation page drawn in a soft hand-drawn character style.

STRUCTURE, top to bottom, as regions of one continuous sheet. No navigation bar, no cards.

REGION 1, the whole screen ground: a soft warm off-white paper, calm and generous, with a very faint paper grain. All the energy comes from the drawings, not the ground.

REGION 2, the top: the words HBD SUMMER PARTY hand-lettered in a chunky rounded friendly marker script in deep ink, slightly irregular, warm and informal, with a tiny smiling face tucked inside the counter of one letter.

REGION 3, the centre, large and generous: a group of FIVE anthropomorphic object-characters standing together in a loose row, ALL FIVE the same size and equally prominent, none in front of the others, all facing the viewer. Each is drawn with a single confident thick hand-drawn outline, filled flat, with two simple dot eyes, a tiny curved smile, and soft rounded limbs — the charming minimal style of a contemporary illustrated city guide. The five are: a BIRTHDAY CAKE with exactly FIVE lit candles at the centre of the row, an inflatable RING FLOAT, a folded TOWEL, a SWIMSUIT, and a bar of SOAP-like bottle of sunscreen. They lean on each other companionably. The cake is the warmest and the obvious heart of the group.

REGION 4, beneath the group: the date 8.28 and FRI 17:00 in a clean rounded sans, deep ink, comfortably sized and quiet compared with the drawing.

REGION 5, the bottom: a small line of Korean text 어반피크닉 워터파티룸 · 분당서현 in a quiet rounded sans, and a soft wavy watermelon-pink line suggesting water across the very bottom edge.

PALETTE, strictly: warm off-white paper, deep near-black outlines, and flat fills in pool turquoise, watermelon pink, soft butter yellow and pale mint, with small warm orange candle flames. No other colour. No gradients, no shading.

Gentle, quirky, warm, friendly, unmistakably a birthday. Drawn for adults rather than for a nursery. No people, no human faces, no logos, no photographs, no prices, no invented text beyond what is specified.
